$comment: Implements spec 03 §2.2 (pack.json: code, name, version, country, issuers, effective_from, supersedes, languages, requires_engine, sources, verification) and §2.3 (semantic versioning and the overridable path list).
title: Curriculum pack manifest (pack.json)
description: Identity, provenance and verification of one immutable pack version.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code such as KE, GB, NG, UG or TZ (spec 03 §2.2).

issuers.description: Issuing bodies such as KICD, KNEC and the Ministry of Education. The first entry is the primary issuer (spec 03 §2.2).

supersedes.description: The exact pack version this one replaces, for example ke-cbc@2024.2.0. Upgrading a programme to this pack is an explicit admin action (spec 03 §2.3).

languages.description: Locale tags this pack ships translations for. Each entry must have a matching key under locales in the pack document (spec 03 §2.1, §8.2).

requires_engine.description: The engine range that can evaluate this pack, for example >=1.0.0 (spec 03 §2.2).

sources.description: One or more cited source documents. Community packs are reviewed against a cited source (spec 03 §2.1); every national special case must cite its source (spec 03 §6).

overridable.description: Paths a school may override within limits declared by the pack (spec 03 §2.3). Overrides are stored on the programme and shown on report footers.

url.description: Link to the published source document (spec 03 §2.2). The spec example uses a placeholder ellipsis until the reviewer supplies the exact URL, so only the presence of a value is checked; the registry review verifies the link.

retrieved.description: The date the source was retrieved, so a later review can tell whether the citation is stale.

status.description: draft means every list and band still needs checking against the cited source; verified means it was reviewed and has conformance vectors (spec 03 §12).

verified_by.description: People or bodies that reviewed this version. Empty is allowed only while the status is draft.

notes.description: Open questions for the reviewer, such as a circular that must be checked before release (spec 03 §2.2).
